content: Namaste Sharks.I want you to close your eyes for a second. Think about that one specific achaar (pickle) or laddu that only your Nani or Dadi used to make. The one you haven’t tasted in 10 years. The one no supermarket brand has ever been able to replicate.You can open your eyes. That taste is disappearing. We are losing our culinary heritage to standardized, preservative-filled packets. But more importantly, the creators of those recipes—millions of women across rural India—are unacknowledged and unpaid.My name is Sahaj, and I am the founder of Viraasat.Viraasat is not just a packaged food brand; it is India’s first "Recipe Licensing" platform. We identify home chefs with unique, generational recipes in Tier-2 and Tier-3 towns. We manufacture and sell their products under our brand, but here is the twist: We treat their recipe as Intellectual Property (IP).For every packet sold, the creator—the "Dadiji" or "Mataji"—gets a distinct Royalty fee, forever. They don't just get a wage; they get ownership. Unka hunar, unki pehchan. (Their talent, their identity.)We launched 8 months ago with just 3 SKUs: A Jackfruit Pickle from Bihar, a Bamboo Shoot chutney from Assam, and a ragi cookie from Karnataka.The Traction:We have sold over 25,000 units.We have a repeat rate of 42%.We have generated ₹65 Lakhs in revenue, with a net margin of 18%.Today, I am here to ensure that no Indian recipe is ever forgotten.The Ask:I am seeking ₹50 Lakhs for 2% equity in Viraasat.Sharks, who wants to build the biggest catalog of Indian taste with me?

content: Shark, you can copy the ingredients, but you cannot copy the process. And in Indian cooking, the 'Hand' (Haath ka Swad) is 90% of the IP. We use a 'Split-Manufacturing' process. The grandma doesn't make the whole jar from A to Z anymore. She prepares the 'wet base' (the mangoes/vegetables). We supply the 'Dry Spice Blend' from our central lab. She doesn't know the exact ratio of the spice blend; we don't know her exact sun-drying timing. The final taste only happens when both parts meet. Even if someone hires her, they don't get the spice blend. If someone steals the spice blend, they don't get her process.
